author: Paul Irwin
name: Squill Database Project
description: A declarative Squill database project (.squillproj) that builds a DACPAC from CREATE-statement .sql files.

Provider.description: The target database engine / provider the DACPAC is built for.

TargetVersion.description: The oldest engine version the DACPAC must work against, as a major (16), minor (8.4), or full version (8.0.13). A floor with no upper bound: newer servers are always accepted. Leave empty for no version constraint.

SdkVersion.description: The version of the Squill.Sdk package the generated project references.
